info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Parking Reservations Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservation Status API provides real-time insights into the status of parking reservations. It allows users to check on the current statuses of their parking reservations, facilitating better planning and management of parking resources. Typical consumers include parking lot administrators, fleet managers, and applications that integrate parking solutions. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance user experience and operational efficiency in managing parking spaces.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all reservations. It provides information on whether reservations are confirmed, pending, or canceled, along with any relevant details.
